script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: “Abraham buys the cave” describes a transaction at the city gate, not an event at the field or cave of Machpelah. “Deeded” is also a difficult word for a 5th-grade reader; consider “became his property.”
“Jacob asks to be buried here” takes place in Egypt, not at Machpelah. Jacob’s later burial there is already covered in the next moment.
